title: TikTok Ads Library Search
description: Search TikTok Ads Library by keyword or exact phrase. Date range is required. Coverage is EU / EEA / UK / Switzerland.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: Keyword or phrase to find in ads. Max 50 characters.

searchType.title: Match type
searchType.description: Exact phrase matches the whole term. Fuzzy phrase matches any or all words in any order.

dateFrom.title: Published from (YYYYMMDD)
dateFrom.description: Start of the ad published range. Must be within the last year. Format YYYYMMDD.

dateTo.title: Published to (YYYYMMDD)
dateTo.description: End of the ad published range. Format YYYYMMDD. Leave empty to use today.

countryCodes.title: Country codes
countryCodes.description: Optional ISO country codes. Leave empty for all supported countries. Examples: FR, DE, IT, GB.

maxAds.title: Max ads
maxAds.description: Stop after this many ads. TikTok returns at most 10 ads per page.

includeDetails.title: Fetch ad details
includeDetails.description: On by default. Adds title, landing URL, call to action, advertiser profile, targeting, and rejection info. Uses one extra API request per ad.

clientKey.title: TikTok client key (optional)
clientKey.description: Override for local tests. Prefer Actor env TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY in production.

clientSecret.title: TikTok client secret (optional)
clientSecret.description: Override for local tests. Prefer Actor env TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET in production.
